CREATE PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMERLOCATION_CRM_enhancement_20230918] AS
BEGIN
---------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation
AS(
	SELECT 
     BCA.ORGKEY AS CustomerId
    ,BCA.ADDRESSCATEGORY AS LocationTypeId
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(64),HASHBYTES('MD5',CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCA.ADDRESSID)),1) AS LocationId
    ,BCA.START_DATE AS PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,BCA.END_DATE AS PeriodEndTimestamp
    ,CASE WHEN BCA.PREFERREDADDRESS = 'Y' AND BCA.END_DATE = '2099-12-31' AND ACCOUNTID <> 0 AND (LEFT(BCA.ORGKEY,1) = 'R' OR  LEFT(BCA.ORGKEY,1) = 'P') THEN 'Y'
		  WHEN BCA.PREFERREDADDRESS = 'Y' AND BCA.END_DATE = '2099-12-31' AND CORP_ID <> 0 AND (LEFT(BCA.ORGKEY,1) = 'C' OR  LEFT(BCA.ORGKEY,1) = 'B') THEN 'Y'
		  ELSE 'N' END AS PreferenceId
    ,BCA.HOLDMAILFLAG AS HoldMailIndicator
    ,BCA.HOLDMAILINITIATEDBY AS HoldMailInitiatedById
    ,BCA.HOLDMAILREASON AS HoldMailReason
	,'CRM' AS SourceCode
	,BCA.INSERT_DTTM
	,BCA.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
	FROM BUSC.CRM_ADDRESS BCA
	WHERE BCA.isLatest=1 

)
SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
 CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerId)
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,LocationTypeId)
,LocationId
,CONVERT(DATE,PeriodStartTimestamp)
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PreferenceId)
,CONVERT(CHAR,HoldMailIndicator)
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,HoldMailInitiatedById)
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,HoldMailReason)
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,FinancialInstitutionId)
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, LocationTypeId, LocationId,FinancialInstitutionId, SourceCode
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation 
) 

,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
 CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerId)
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,LocationTypeId)
,LocationId
,CONVERT(DATE,PeriodStartTimestamp)
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PreferenceId)
,CONVERT(CHAR,HoldMailIndicator)
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,HoldMailInitiatedById)
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,HoldMailReason)
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,FinancialInstitutionId)
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, LocationTypeId, LocationId,FinancialInstitutionId, SourceCode
FROM BNKM.CustomerLocation_enhancement_20230918 WHERE SourceCode = 'CRM' AND PeriodEndTimestamp = '2099-12-31T00:00:00.0000000' 

)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
	,ISNULL(SRC.LocationTypeId,TGT.LocationTypeId) AS LocationTypeId
	,ISNULL(SRC.LocationId,TGT.LocationId) AS LocationId
	,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,ISNULL(SRC.SourceCode,TGT.SourceCode) AS SourceCode
	,CASE
		WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS

FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation_SRC	SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
AND SRC.LocationTypeId = TGT.LocationTypeId
AND SRC.LocationId = TGT.LocationId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceCode = TGT.SourceCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW  OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)
SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation_DELTA;


-----------UPDATE TO BNKM
--UPDATE TGT 
--SET
--[PeriodEndTimestamp] = SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp
--FROM BNKM.CustomerLocation TGT
--JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation_DELTA DELTA 
--ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId 
--AND DELTA.LocationTypeId = TGT.LocationTypeId
--AND DELTA.LocationId = TGT.LocationId
--AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
--AND DELTA.SourceCode = TGT.SourceCode
--AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
--JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation SRC 
--ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
--AND SRC.LocationTypeId = TGT.LocationTypeId
--AND SRC.LocationId = TGT.LocationId
--AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
--AND SRC.SourceCode = TGT.SourceCode
--WHERE TGT.PeriodEndTimestamp = '2099-12-31T00:00:00.0000000' ;
 



-------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerLocation_enhancement_20230918  ( 
[CustomerId]
,[LocationTypeId]
,[LocationId]
,[PeriodStartTimestamp]
,[PeriodEndTimestamp]
,[GlobalLocationNumber]
,[PreferenceId]
,[CustomerLocationNote]
,[HoldMailIndicator]
,[HoldMailInitiatedById]
,[HoldMailReason]
,[SourceCode]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[TaskRunId]
,[InsertDttm])

SELECT 
SRC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
,SRC.LocationTypeId AS LocationTypeId
,SRC.LocationId AS LocationId
,SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp AS PeriodStartTimestamp
,SRC.PeriodEndTimestamp AS PeriodEndTimestamp
,NULL AS GlobalLocationNumber
,SRC.PreferenceId AS PreferenceId
,NULL AS CustomerLocationNote
,SRC.HoldMailIndicator AS HoldMailIndicator
,SRC.HoldMailInitiatedById AS HoldMailInitiatedById
,SRC.HoldMailReason AS HoldMailReason
,'CRM' AS SourceCode
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,SRC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
--INTO bnkm.CustomerLocation_enhancement_20230918
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation_DELTA DELTA	
 ON  DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId 
 AND DELTA.LocationTypeId = SRC.LocationTypeId 
 AND DELTA.LocationId = SRC.LocationId 
 AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId 
 AND DELTA.SourceCode = SRC.SourceCode 
 WHERE DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT');


DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation_DELTA;

END
